title: French Canadian Noodle Casserole
description: A rich and comforting casserole that combines the flavors of France and Canada. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Cook Canadian noodle according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add lightly seasoned dish and stir to combine.
Add flour and whisk to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in grated cheddar until melted.
Add cooked Canadian noodle to the skillet and toss to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a baking dish and top with additional grated cheddar if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
